tasks.text: The keyboard and mouse are the most important input devices.
A scanner converts a paper image into a digital file.
A webcam is an essential tool for video calls.
A microphone converts sound waves into electrical signals.
A touchpad is the built-in pointing device on laptops.
The USB connector is the most widespread connection method.
We use a mouse or a touchpad to move the cursor.
We can type capital letters using the Shift key.
The Backspace key allows us to delete incorrect characters.
A controller or joystick is often used for games.
